name: Screen director
description: Decides by itself what to show, shrink or hide on the main screen based on what you are doing, avoids duplicates and learns from your corrections. While you talk it can float particle sculptures of the objects you mention, stored in a fast library for instant reuse.
capabilities: When you talk by voice the chat shrinks and comes back as soon as you type
Never two indicators saying the same thing
Learns: if you reopen something it hid, it leaves it next time
Particle sculptures that burst and reform while you talk
Signed particle library reused without regenerating
Rust engine when available, with an equivalent Python fallback
